purpose: Independently challenge omissions, arithmetic and practical value of the prospectively fixed FDA solid-tumor ADC antigen panel. Source-gate pass authorizes a bounded exploratory expression pilot, not manuscript promotion.
source_gate: Eight distinct approved BLAs as of 2026-10-05 match independently retrieved official DrugsFDA original AP decisions; description plus mechanism searches avoid the Padcev omission of a mechanism-only query. Hematologic CD123/BCMA/CD79b/CD30/CD33/CD19/CD22 products and non-antibody conjugates excluded by disease/agent scope.
prior_exposure: Davis2017 already reports two FOLR1 RNA outliers among five RNA-evaluable EMC cases. Prior broad gene screening, ERBB2 flat and MET array discordance mean this is exploratory re-evaluation. No selected high-case novelty.
strongest_alternatives: Bulk RNA may be stromal, endothelial, epithelial or normal-tissue admixture, without EMC tumor-cell accessible protein.
Isoforms, soluble tissue factor, probe annotation, culture adaptation and cross-platform units may explain apparent contrasts.
Unresolved donors, archival overlap and source-year confounding prevent unconditional independence or biological replication claims.
Common expression or previous published findings may remove useful novelty even if the frozen arithmetic thresholds pass.
independent_checks: Verify fixed universe and approval cutoff; retain unharmonized labels and aliases.
Search primary EMC and broader series containing EMC; distinguish study enrollment from case-level molecular authentication, protein and clinical response.
Bind owner final freeze and original input hashes; independently project all six genes through every accessible eligible EMC condition and fixed comparators without post-hoc probe selection.
Challenge all 13 RNA samples, nine non-overlap primary rows, all six/ten/four historical assay conditions and three authenticated model readouts; unavailable mapping remains distinct from absence.
Check normal/compartment context, cohort-year comparison, half-tie A, deletion sensitivity and exploratory multiplicity.
Apply validity and scientific-value decisions separately; accessible relevant public measurements left pending block promotion.
stop: Finish the 30-minute initial source/value gate and report omissions. If no panel contrast plus useful unanswered contribution survives, recommend shelving; do not append targets or select a favorable subset. Additional owner freeze checking is a named integration dependency, not a new panel search.
